items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: I know when I was working with Basin Street 6, he was at the Roosevelt

ctx.x: At least that long, because I remember hearing that man on the radio playing music at least 25 years ago.

Well, I know when I was working with Basin Street 6, he was at the Roosevelt, but he would come in and out. That's when they were using different bands. He was like the house band. But he would come in and out more than anybody else.
Well, look, Kevin, thank you. Thank you very much. Thank you, sir.
